title: What Is Your Dominant Personality Archetype?
subtitle: Uncover the psychological pattern driving your decisions, instincts, and natural strengths.

questions.text: When facing a chaotic, unexpected crisis, what is your initial reflex?

options.text: Step up immediately, take command, and assign tasks.
Look for an unconventional, out-of-the-box workaround.
Step back to quietly analyze data and identify root causes.
Check in on everyone to make sure people feel safe and supported.

questions.text: Which compliment feels most meaningful and energizing to you?

options.text: 'You got results when nobody else could.'
'I have never seen anyone come up with an idea like that.'
'Your explanation made a complex truth so simple and clear.'
'Your presence made this entire situation feel reassuring.'

questions.text: What is your biggest personal pet peeve in daily life?

options.text: Indecision, hesitation, and lack of accountability.
Rigid bureaucracy and doing things 'because that is how it has always been done'.
Superficial opinions formed without research or logic.
Cold indifference, cruelty, and unnecessary selfishness.

questions.text: Pick your ideal weekend pursuit without commitments:

options.text: Organizing your personal goals and setting up next month's strategy.
Building, writing, painting, or experimenting with a fresh concept.
Devouring a book or documentary on a fascinating deep subject.
Hosting a warm gathering or cooking a wholesome dinner for close friends.

questions.text: What do your friends naturally seek most from you?

options.text: Direction, momentum, and high standards.
Inspiration, humor, and fresh angles on life.
Wisdom, clarity, and objective perspective.
Empathy, loyalty, and a safe place to speak freely.

questions.text: In a major collaborative team project, which role feels second nature to you?

options.text: The strategist setting milestones, driving focus, and securing deadlines.
The solutions architect pitching bold concepts and creative directions.
The critical analyst stress-testing assumptions and mitigating risks.
The culture champion maintaining morale, trust, and team cohesion.

leader.title: The Commander / Sovereign
leader.description: You are recognized for clarity, decisiveness, and natural command. Unafraid of difficult choices, you turn confusion and ambiguity into structure and concrete results.

creator.title: The Visionary / Creator
creator.description: Your mind spots possibility where others see constraints. While monotonous routines drain you, genuine autonomy unleashes breakthrough ideas that inspire everyone.

thinker.title: The Sage / Thinker
thinker.description: You are driven by truth, objective rigor, and deep understanding. You possess the rare gift of distilling intricate concepts into clear, actionable wisdom.

caregiver.title: The Guardian / Caregiver
caregiver.description: Your greatest strength is emotional intelligence, empathy, and steadfast loyalty. You keep groups bonded, notice what others miss, and cultivate safety.
